facts.fact: A National Bank of Rwanda directive issued in January 2026 required domestic interoperable retail payments between banks and electronic money issuers to move to the eKash platform, per ITWeb Africa reporting RSwitch.
facts.system: BNR directive of January 2026 on eKash

facts.fact: Following the central bank's January 2026 directive, from 14 July 2026 all transfers between bank accounts and electronic money issuers (account-to-wallet, wallet-to-account, account-to-account, wallet-to-wallet) are routed through eKash, per RSwitch.
facts.system: BNR directive of January 2026 on eKash

facts.fact: The Rwanda Bankers' Association states that Directive No. 45/2026 was issued by the National Bank of Rwanda on 9 January 2026 and completed the transition of bank and e-money issuer transfers to eKash.

The Rwanda Bankers' Association states that, effective 14 July 2026 under Directive No. 45/2026, every transfer between banks and electronic money issuers runs through the single eKash instant payment rail.

systems.country_label: eKash (Rwanda National Digital Payment System, RNDPS)

facts.fact: Digital Policy Alert says Rwanda implemented the Law Governing the Payment System in November 2021, setting licensing requirements for payment providers.

Digital Policy Alert says the National Bank of Rwanda issued a regulation in September 2023 on licensing procedures for digital payment providers, after earlier licensing rules for electronic money issuers.
